name: payproof
description: Payment correctness testing for TypeScript applications

scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm -r exec tsc --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.pack:check: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @payproof/core pack --pack-destination ./reports && pnpm --filter @payproof/sdk pack --pack-destination ./reports && pnpm --filter @payproof/bachs pack --pack-destination ./reports && pnpm --filter @payproof/cli pack --pack-destination ./reports
